verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev provides durable task execution with checkpointed retries (exponential backoff), waitpoints/human-approval pauses that keep runs alive mid-execution, versioning locks, concurrency queues, and explicit durable multi-turn AI chat/agent tasks that survive refreshes, deploys, and crashes — directly matching the durable LLM agent loop story, with a needsApproval tool pattern and community confirmation of long-running OpenAI call chains. missing for 10: no independent hands-on benchmark of an actual multi-step agent loop surviving a real crash mid-run (only docs/community anecdotes), and some community feedback notes wished-for wait/resume gaps in earlier versions.
